output_name.label: Output name
output_name.description: The player's name in Music Assistant and, unless a session name is set, the stream's name on the network.

address.label: Destination address
address.description: Where the stream goes: a multicast group (AES67 usually uses 239.x.x.x) or the IPv4 address of one receiver.

channels.label: Stream channels
channels.description: Channels in the AES67 stream. Several outputs can share one stream (the same address and port) on different channels.

channel_map.label: Channel map
channel_map.description: Which stream channels this output plays on: '1,2' sends left to channel 1 and right to channel 2; one number (such as '5') sends a mono downmix.

sample_rate.label: Sample rate
sample_rate.description: AES67 receivers expect 48 kHz unless set otherwise.

ptime_us.label: Packet time
ptime_us.description: 1 ms is the AES67 default every receiver accepts.

ttl.label: Multicast TTL
ttl.description: How many routers a multicast stream may cross.

session_name.label: Session name
session_name.description: The name receivers see in SAP and NMOS; the output name when empty.

keep_alive.label: Send silence while idle
keep_alive.description: Keep the stream running between tracks and while stopped, so receivers stay subscribed.

sender_host.label: AES67 Sender address
sender_host.description: Where the AES67 Sender add-on runs. 127.0.0.1 when it runs on the same Home Assistant host.

sender_port.label: AES67 Sender port
sender_port.description: The add-on's control API port (8890 by default).

sender_token.label: AES67 Sender token
sender_token.description: The add-on's API token, if one is set.

errors.cannot_connect: The AES67 Sender did not answer at this address and port. Check that the add-on is running.
errors.invalid_token: The AES67 Sender refused the token.
errors.invalid_output: This output's settings are not valid.
